C0091.title: Browser Plugin Hijacks Traffic: Baidu Sues Operator and Wins Compensation
C0091.summary: The 'New Media Manager Plus' browser plugin operated by Shanghai Zhengkai Information Technology Co., Ltd. inserted links into Baidu web pages, forcibly redirecting traffic to its own website. After Baidu filed a lawsuit, the court ordered Zhengkai to compensate for economic losses and eliminate the adverse effects.
